blurb: Seattle Farm is a 20+ acre working horse farm in South Seattle, family-owned since 1919. Guests can pick organic apples and pumpkins, ride ponies, attend pony camps, lease horses, and book private events including weddings. The farm offers a rustic setting with horses, barns, and open pastures for various activities and celebrations.
extraNote: Admission is in advance and prices rise a few days before event · No dogs allowed at events · No outside food allowed at pumpkin event · All leases are month-to-month; horse maintenance covered by farm · If photo shoot date/time unavailable, 100% refund given · Seattle Farm is an open-caterer venue for events · 4506 South Bond Street, Seattle, WA 98118; drive past the big yellow house, down the gravel driveway, and park in the meadow.
